narratives.Overview: OtterFlop is a non-commercial web-based game for a 4-year-old centered on caring for cute otters. It should be simple, calm, touch-friendly, and appropriate for short daily check-ins before bed.
narratives.TechStack: Web App using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with a touch-first interface optimized for Amazon Fire tablet browsers.
narratives.Quality: Run task check before every commit. Achieve >= 85% coverage overall + per-module where measurable. Prioritize fast load, large touch targets, and resilient offline-friendly state handling.
narratives.ProjectRules: Non-commercial. Theme is taking care of cute otters. Must run on an Amazon Fire tablet. Must save state so the child can check on her otters each night.
